title: Passing Departmental Examinations & Service Confirmation Are Not Prerequisites For Grant Of ACP/MACP Benefits : Jharkhand HC
description: A Division Bench of the Jharkhand High Court comprising Chief Justice M.S. Sonak and Justice Rajesh Shankar held that passing departmental examinations and service confirmation are not prerequisites for grant of ACP/MACP benefits, which are designed to provide monetary relief against stagnation. Background Facts The employee was appointed on the post of Junior Accounts Clerk by the respondent. Later he passed 'Hindi Noting & Drafting Examination'.
